item.title: Re: NEW SCP IDEA: Seeking Greenlights
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi Msalmeen. Let’s take a look at your concept.

Okay… I apologise, but what is going on here? You’ve gone into a lot of detail in your sections, but after reading everything, I still don’t understand what the SCP is and what it’s supposed to do.

I would encourage you to significantly revise your concept pitch to make it clearer. Your elevator pitch should be a summary of the key description of who the scp is and what it can do. Your central narrative should describe (briefly) how the scp was discovered / what the Foundation does to contain it etc. And finally, your Hook should briefly describe the overall themes / why your scp is different from others.

You can check out other concept pitches (like this one) to get a sense of how it should be written.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. For now, all the best!

item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
